items.title: Vanishing of the zeroth local cohomology of the dualizing complex forces the cohomological dimension below the dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement deduces a strict bound on the cohomological dimension of an ideal from the vanishing of the zeroth local cohomology of the normalized dualizing complex of a Noetherian local ring (author lemma at source lines 3648-3654, label lemma-cd-bound-dualizing). The proof (source lines 3656-3691) uses the degree and support bounds for the cohomology of the dualizing complex to isolate the top one, picks by prime avoidance an element outside the minimal primes of maximal dimension killing all lower cohomology modules, and then uses the truncation triangle together with the vanishing of an endomorphism of a truncation to factor a power of that element through the top module (proof lines 3668-3683); the divisibility and vanishing criteria of this chapter then conclude. The triangulated-category step that turns the annihilation into a factorisation is the content. H3.
